company.name: SellRaze
company.shortDescription: SellRaze offers a cross-listing app for identifying, pricing, and listing items quickly across multiple marketplaces.
company.description: SellRaze provides a cross-listing app that identifies, prices, and lists items in seconds. Users can take images of their items and select their preferred marketplaces for listing. The platform supports reselling automation, allowing users to manage listings, logistics, and inventory from a centralized interface. SellRaze aims to streamline the online selling process, making it faster and more efficient for users to sell their products.

productsAndServices.description: An application that identifies, prices, and lists items across multiple online marketplaces to facilitate quick sales.
